title: The Greatest High in the World Is Your Own Soul - Wednesday: Maamar Yafeh Sha'ah Achas #2
blurb: You're Not Sick; You Just Never Felt Your Own Energy What if the greatest high you will ever experience is not found in a substance, a relationship, an achievement, or an extraordinary experience—but in your own soul? What if you could learn to generate your own energy, feel deeply alive from within, and experience a joy and vitality that do not depend on the world around you? In this revolutionary Chassidus class, we explore one of the most extraordinary teachings about the human psyche: the secret of loving Hashem "with all your heart" is learning how to live continuously connected to your own deepest Divine energy. When you are rooted in your authentic self, you reclaim your agency. You stop outsourcing your aliveness to other people, experiences, accomplishments, or external stimulation. You discover an infinite reservoir of vitality, passion, connection, and love already pulsating within your soul. And here lies the magnificent paradox: the more deeply you inhabit your own soul, the more profoundly you become connected to everything and everyone. When you touch the deepest truth of your being, you discover that you are not separate from the universe, because at the deepest level, all existence emerges from one Divine reality. This is why the greatest "addicts" in the world are the tzaddikim! They have discovered the ultimate source of ecstasy.
